label: Access
short: Staff with a paid AI plan bought by the organisation, counted (bundled Workspace or 365 features excluded).
strong: Most staff have a bought plan. The question is what it is used for: see Spread.
middle: Some paid plans, up to about half of staff; the rest on personal accounts or the bundled features. The guide to verification and safety at work says what may go in; decide the rest from that.
edge: No bought plan. Free tiers and bundled features are fine for public material. Where staff use personal accounts for work, that is where donor data leaks, and a bought plan is the fix. An organisation paying for API use with no seats is a different case, and the pilot watches for it. Start with the guide to verification and safety at work.
unmet: Ask whoever pays the invoices. A plan is either bought or not.
